name: 993 engine cooling fan housing and impeller subassembly, F0

coordinate_system.origin: F0 assumption at the center of the common front face of the housing and the impeller
coordinate_system.axes: X and Y in the plane of rotation, Z along the fan axis toward the rear of the engine

interfaces.acceptance_rule: cold_radial_clearance_mm >= required_minimum_radial_clearance_mm and hot_radial_clearance_mm >= required_minimum_radial_clearance_mm and BRep intersection volume == 0
measured rotating duty and excitation spectrum are consistent with the stationary assembly and preserve positive clearance
measured fan and system curves intersect at an approved operating point with acceptable cylinder distribution and thermal margin

known_limits: Both geometries and their coaxial alignment at the front plane are unmeasured F0 assumptions.
The cold radial clearance is -14 mm and the BRep test detects a collision; the subassembly therefore fails integration.
The flow targets, speeds and blade counts come from separate regressions and are inconsistent with one another.
No shaft, bearing, alternator, pulley, belt, shim, sheet metal, seal or vehicle transform is modeled.
No Physics/SimReady assignment, PhysicsNeMo simulation, physical validation or manufacturing authorization is claimed.
